name: check_domain_relevance
description: Determines if the user's request is related to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) generation using Terraform. This tool should be used as a preliminary check before attempting to construct any infrastructure information or proceeding with IaC generation.

status.description: True if the user's request is directly related to generating, defining, or managing cloud infrastructure using Terraform. False if the request is a general question, asks for information unrelated to infrastructure, or is outside the scope of IaC generation.

explanation.description: A concise sentence explaining why the user's request is or is not considered relevant to the IaC Terraform generation domain.
